title: Introducing SpellingBee: The Entomological Spellcheck Dictionary
content: Entomologists are, like it or not, professional writers. Research articles, grant proposals, agency reports, lesson plans, and more all add up to a considerable chunk of our time—time many of us might prefer to spend outside catching bugs. Whatever our wants, our written work is too important to neglect for long, and for some of us, it is the metric by which our success is measured. Fortunately, writers today have access to more tools than ever to expedite the writing process. One of those tools, however, often feels like it’s working against us, not for us: the spellchecker.
